claude_code: claude mcp add --scope user actual -e ACTUAL_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5006 -e ACTUAL_PASSWORD=${ACTUAL_PASSWORD} -e ACTUAL_BUDGET_SYNC_ID=${ACTUAL_BUDGET_SYNC_ID} -e ACTUAL_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.actual-mcp -- npx -y actual-mcp
notes: Read-only by default; add --enable-write to args to allow creating transactions. Requires self-hosted Actual server (Docker).
